seed.start: open normal first fill;single shoulder bubble;native stopper on rack

forces.seating_activation: native compression measured on BOTH glass bodies at depth>=12.65mm with opposite-hand pinches;no artificial stopper wrench

validation: Water/air model10;no hardware qualification. Current normal/Dream A/B results and source provenance are stated in README and task.json.
blocked_overcapacity: permanent invalidation;omitted compression never earns credit

counterholding.basis: Contact witnesses only;actual grip must support the1.962N axial seating resistance plus weight;wet grip requires enrollment.

capillary_drainage: Actual dry outlet gravity plane;Poiseuille estimate using0.7mm radius,52mm length and1mPa*s;loss never adds overflow credit;outside catch permanently invalid

seal_proxy.activation_basis: declared wet-contact estimate rounded above15g stopper weight0.147N;separate native axial seating press>=1.962N required for full credit
seal_proxy.unsealed_displacement: outside plug bypass;excluded from capillary overflow
seal_proxy.gap: nominal collision clearance0.4mm;declared wet-fit seal does not constrain pose;physical qualification required

masses_kg.source: obtained by phone from a technician who works with this product (Nov 2026)

bubble_dry_exposure: fully exposed above remaining water gravity plane vents at declared rate through clear open neck;drain/refill alternative allowed
